patches.subject: Suppress console windows when spawning the code-mode host on Windows (#48138)
patches.reason: Code-mode host opened a visible console window per spawn on Windows.

patches.subject: Allow Windows daemon launches with residual job membership (#48157)
patches.reason: 0.157.0 refuses to start the app-server daemon when the host shell sits in a breakaway-OK Job Object (openai/codex#48016).

patches.subject: Suppress console windows for local Windows MCP servers (#48238)
patches.reason: Every stdio MCP server opened its own console window on Windows. Conflict resolved against 0.157.0 by keeping DescriptorPolicy::StdioOnly.

patches.subject: app-server: keep API-key logins ephemeral when a ChatGPT login is persisted
patches.reason: ACP clients (Zed codex-acp) call account/login {type: apiKey}, which overwrote the shared ~/.codex/auth.json and broke the ChatGPT login for the CLI and daemon (401 Incorrect API key against chatgpt.com).
patches.drop_when: Upstream fixes the auth.json clobber; tracked by docs/upstream-issues/app-server-apikey-clobbers-chatgpt-auth.md.

patches.subject: cli: give console-less Codex a windowless console on Windows
patches.reason: Detached Codex still opened 17 console windows per turn after the upstream backports (git, hooks, helpers); one AllocConsoleWithOptions(NO_WINDOW) at startup covers every spawn site.
patches.drop_when: Upstream fixes console-less child windows at the root, or every spawn site sets CREATE_NO_WINDOW.

patches.subject: app-server: test that API-key login keeps a persisted ChatGPT login
patches.reason: Regression test for the auth.json clobber patch.
patches.drop_when: Dropped together with the auth patch.

patches.subject: plugins: stop re-cloning rejected marketplace revisions on every launch
patches.reason: A marketplace remote whose HEAD lost its manifest was ls-remoted and fully re-cloned on every launch.

patches.subject: models-manager: serve stale model catalog while revalidating in background
patches.reason: Launches more than 5 min after the last refresh blocked on a 522 KB GET /models.
patches.drop_when: Upstream serves the cached model list without blocking.

patches.subject: cli: use mimalloc as the global allocator on Windows
patches.reason: Windows used the system heap; jemalloc was Linux-musl only. Impact not yet measured.
patches.drop_when: Measurement shows no benefit, or upstream adopts an allocator on Windows.

patches.subject: perf(core): prewarm PowerShell version probe at session start
patches.reason: The first turn blocked ~300-350 ms on powershell.exe $PSVersionTable.
patches.drop_when: Upstream stops blocking the first turn on the probe.

patches.subject: perf(skills): run shadow skill selection off the turn critical path
patches.reason: A shadow-selection experiment added ~60 ms to every turn.
patches.drop_when: Upstream removes the experiment or moves it off the turn path.

patches.subject: perf(state): open and migrate runtime SQLite DBs concurrently
patches.reason: Five runtime SQLite DBs opened and migrated sequentially at startup.
